brief:
Five deaths in a single night expose what Shehab Wire describes as a year-long deception surrounding the ceasefire in Gaza. The agency reports that killing has not ceased but merely changed form, with large-scale warfare declining while airstrikes, targeted assassinations, gunfire, and house demolitions persist.

The characterization challenges the ceasefire's substance, suggesting operations have continued under a different operational posture rather than ending violence.

title: Five killed in Gaza night expose ceasefire deception
